description: This file defines the Monitor class and related nested classes and data structures for monitoring system memory and operational status within the WPEFramework Plugin architecture. It includes class declarations, JSON serialization structures, and interface implementations for plugin lifecycle and web interactions.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData
classes.description: Holds memory measurement data including resident, allocated, shared, and process metrics.

classes.name: Monitor::Data
classes.description: Represents monitoring data for a specific observable, including name, measurements, observable string, and restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData::Measurement
classes.description: Stores min, max, average, and last values for a specific measurement type.

classes.name: Monitor::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for monitor observables, including restart limits and operational parameters.

classes.name: Monitor::Config::Entry
classes.description: Represents a single observable configuration with callsign, memory limits, operational flag, and restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects
classes.description: Manages a collection of monitor objects, handles plugin notifications, lifecycle, and periodic evaluation of monitored entities.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObject
classes.description: Represents a monitored entity with memory and operational status, restart management, and evaluation logic.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two unsigned integers.

methods.name: Monitor::MetaData::AddMeasurements
methods.description: Adds memory measurements to the MetaData object.

methods.name: Monitor::MetaData::Measure
methods.description: Updates memory measurements from an IMemory interface.

methods.name: Monitor::Data::Data
methods.description: Constructs a Data object with specified name, measurements, observable, and restart info.

methods.name: Monitor::Config::Entry::Entry
methods.description: Initializes a configuration entry with default values.

methods.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects::Open
methods.description: Initializes monitoring for a set of observables based on configuration, starts periodic evaluation.

methods.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects::Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the current state of monitored objects, triggers deactivation if thresholds are exceeded.
